extra_vocab.en: connected to or linked with something
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，associated with invoice G198494551 放在 plan 後面修飾它，意思是「和這張發票有關的（方案）」。這是客服信常見的說法，用來精準指出是哪一筆費用或帳戶。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: associated with 是過去分詞片語，放在名詞後面修飾（the plan associated with the invoice）；介系詞固定用 with，不用 to。

examples.en: Please send the files associated with this order number.
examples.zh: 請寄出與這個訂單編號相關的檔案。

examples.en: The costs associated with shipping are listed on the invoice.
examples.zh: 與運送相關的費用列在發票上。

examples.en: We discussed the risks associated with the new payment system.
examples.zh: 我們討論了與新付款系統相關的風險。

examples.en: I could not find any account associated with this email address.
examples.zh: 我找不到與這個電子郵件地址相關的任何帳戶。

examples.en: The brand is strongly associated with high quality service.
examples.zh: 這個品牌與高品質服務有很強的連結。

similar.diff: related to 較口語、範圍較廣；associated with 常用來指和帳戶、費用、風險等連結的項目。

example.en: Questions related to billing should go to the finance team.
example.zh: 與帳務相關的問題請交給財務團隊。

similar.diff: linked to 強調兩件事之間有明確的連結或因果關係。

example.en: The error is linked to a recent software update.
example.zh: 這個錯誤與最近的軟體更新有關。

confusable.diff: affiliated with 指「隸屬於、附屬於」某個組織；associated with 只表示有關聯。

example.en: She is affiliated with a local trade association.
example.zh: 她隸屬於一個地方商業協會。

extra_vocab.en: worked out as a part of the full price, based on the time used
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，prorated refund 指依實際使用天數按比例算出的退款。信中提醒：取消方案本身不會產生這種退款，當月剩餘期間的費用仍須支付。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: prorated 放在名詞前當形容詞（a prorated refund）；動詞 prorate 常用被動，如 be prorated。

example.en: The company prorates the fee for customers who join mid-month.
example.zh: 公司會替月中加入的客戶按比例計算費用。

example.en: We are prorating your charge based on the days you used.
example.zh: 我們正依你的使用天數按比例計算費用。

example.en: Customers who cancel early can request a prorated refund within thirty days.
example.zh: 提早取消的客戶可在三十天內申請按比例退款。

example.en: Please check the prorated amount on the attached statement.
example.zh: 請查看附件帳單上按比例計算的金額。

example.en: Fees are charged on a prorated basis during the first month.
example.zh: 第一個月的費用按比例計收。

examples.en: You will receive a prorated refund for the unused days.
examples.zh: 你會收到未使用天數的按比例退款。

examples.en: The first invoice shows a prorated amount for twelve days.
examples.zh: 第一張發票顯示十二天按比例計算的金額。

examples.en: Rent is prorated if you move in after the first of the month.
examples.zh: 如果你在月初之後搬入，租金會按比例計算。

examples.en: Part-time staff receive prorated benefits based on their working hours.
examples.zh: 兼職員工依工時按比例享有福利。

confusable.diff: proportional 是「成比例的」，描述兩個數量之間的關係；prorated 是依時間或比例實際算出的金額。

example.en: Bonuses are proportional to each employee's sales results.
example.zh: 獎金與每位員工的業績成比例。

example.en: The refund will reach your account within five business days.
example.zh: 退款會在五個工作天內進到你的帳戶。

example.en: There is no charge for the first month of service.
example.zh: 服務的第一個月不收費。

example.en: A small fee applies if you cancel after the deadline.
example.zh: 如果在期限後取消，會收取一筆小額費用。

example.en: We offered a partial refund because the trial was half used.
example.zh: 因為試用期已使用一半，我們提供部分退款。

derived.zh: 按比例分攤、按比例計算
derived.link: prorate + -ion，把「按比例計算」變成名詞，像 donate → donation

example.en: The bank will send a prorated bill for the first month.
example.zh: 銀行會寄出第一個月按比例計算的帳單。

pos_uses.zh: 按比例分攤、按比例計算

example.en: We prorate the annual fee when a customer joins in July.
example.zh: 客戶七月加入時，我們會按比例計算年費。

extra_vocab.en: the part that is left after the rest is used or taken
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，the remainder of the month 指這個月還沒過完的那段時間。信中說明取消後仍須支付當月剩餘期間的費用。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 表示「剩下的時間」要用 for the remainder of + 時間，of 不可省略，前面通常加 the。

example.en: The remainders from each shipment were returned to the supplier.
example.zh: 每批貨剩下的東西都退回給供應商了。

collocations.phrase: for the remainder of the year

example.en: The office will stay closed for the remainder of the year.
example.zh: 辦公室在今年剩下的時間都會關閉。

example.en: Please save the remainder of the budget for next quarter.
example.zh: 請把剩下的預算留到下一季。

example.en: Please pay the remainder when the goods arrive.
example.zh: 貨物送達時請付清餘款。

examples.en: You will be billed for the remainder of the billing period.
examples.zh: 你會被收取本計費期間剩餘時間的費用。

examples.en: I will explain the remainder of the plan after the break.
examples.zh: 休息後我會說明計畫的其餘部分。

examples.en: We spent the remainder of the trip visiting client offices.
examples.zh: 我們把出差剩下的時間用來拜訪客戶辦公室。

confusable.diff: reminder 是「提醒（通知）」；remainder 是「剩下的部分」，兩字只差幾個字母。

example.en: Please send a reminder to everyone before the Friday meeting.
example.zh: 請在星期五的會議前向大家發出提醒。

example.en: The balance on your account is now zero.
example.zh: 你帳戶的餘額現在是零。

example.en: I will send the rest of the files tomorrow morning.
example.zh: 我明天早上會寄出其餘的檔案。

derived.link: remain 是基礎動詞「剩下」；remainder 就是「剩下的東西」
remain + -ing，當形容詞用，表示「剩下的」，像 the remaining balance

extra_vocab.en: to meet or find something, often a problem
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，encounter any issues 是客氣的說法，指在取消方案過程中「遇到任何問題」。if 子句用現在式，後面接祈使句請對方提供截圖。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: encounter 是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞，不加介系詞（不要寫 encounter with）。

example.en: Our team often encounters delays when shipping goods overseas.
example.zh: 我們的團隊在海外運送貨物時常遇到延誤。

example.en: His encounters with difficult customers taught him to stay calm.
example.zh: 他與難搞客戶的接觸教會他保持冷靜。

example.en: Several users encountered errors while updating the payment details.
example.zh: 有幾位使用者在更新付款資料時遇到錯誤。

example.en: Customers encountering login errors should contact the help desk.
example.zh: 遇到登入錯誤的客戶應聯絡服務台。

example.en: Please call us if you encounter a problem with your order.
example.zh: 如果你的訂單出現問題，請打電話給我們。

example.en: New staff may encounter difficulties during the first week.
example.zh: 新進員工在第一週可能會遇到困難。

example.en: If you encounter an error message, please take a screenshot.
example.zh: 如果你看到錯誤訊息，請截圖。

examples.en: Let us know if you encounter any trouble with the website.
examples.zh: 如果你在使用網站時遇到任何麻煩，請告訴我們。

examples.en: Customers sometimes encounter long wait times during holiday sales.
examples.zh: 假日特賣期間，客戶有時會遇到很長的等待時間。

examples.en: We encountered heavy traffic on the way to the client meeting.
examples.zh: 我們在前往客戶會議的路上遇到嚴重塞車。

examples.en: The team encountered unexpected costs while building the new office.
examples.zh: 團隊在建造新辦公室時遇到了意料之外的費用。

confusable.diff: encourage 是「鼓勵」；encounter 是「遇到」，兩字拼法開頭相近。
confusable.usage: encounter 後面直接接受詞（遇到的問題或人）；encourage 要用 encourage + 人 + to V。

example.en: The manager will encourage staff to share their ideas.
example.zh: 經理會鼓勵員工分享他們的想法。

similar.diff: run into 較口語，可指遇到問題或偶然遇見人；encounter 較正式，適合書信。

example.en: We ran into some problems while updating the customer database.
example.zh: 我們在更新客戶資料庫時遇到了一些問題。

similar.diff: face 強調「面對」困難或挑戰，語氣比 encounter 更直接。

example.en: Many small businesses face high costs this year.
example.zh: 許多小型企業今年面臨高成本。

example.en: We solved the problem before the customer called again.
example.zh: 我們在客戶再次來電前就解決了問題。

example.en: She had difficulty logging in to the payment portal.
example.zh: 她登入付款入口網站時遇到困難。

example.en: Please describe the issue in as much detail as possible.
example.zh: 請盡量詳細描述這個問題。

example.en: Employees may encounter problems when they first use the new system.
example.zh: 員工第一次使用新系統時可能會遇到問題。

example.en: The first encounter with the client went very smoothly.
example.zh: 第一次與客戶接觸進行得非常順利。

senses.en: to meet a problem or difficulty while doing something

example.en: Users may encounter delays when the server is busy.
example.zh: 伺服器忙碌時，使用者可能會遇到延遲。

senses.en: to meet someone without planning to
senses.distinguish: 後面接 problem、error 等是「遇到」；接人是「偶然遇見」。

example.en: I encountered an old colleague at the airport yesterday.
example.zh: 我昨天在機場巧遇一位老同事。
